_doc: AS-41 r1 (P1-1) negative fixtures: ordinary teaching turns whose replies contain <var> = <number> but no exercise answer. Tutor and Reviewer guards must pass them through unchanged. Used by src/lib/__tests__/agent-method-guard.test.ts and the AS-27 runner ROLE check.

fixtures.reply:
Newton's second law: F = ma.
Example: a cart with m = 2 kg pushed by F = 10 N.
Then a = F/m, so the cart accelerates at 5 m/s².
Near Earth, g = 9.8 m/s².
Example: if a = 2 and b = 3, then a+b is 5.

fixtures.prompt: how do I model free fall?

fixtures.reply: דוגמה: אם a = 2 ו-b = 3, אז a+b הוא 5.

fixtures.prompt: תלמד אותי את החוק השני של ניוטון
fixtures.reply:
החוק השני של ניוטון: F = ma.
דוגמה: עגלה עם m = 2 kg שנדחפת בכוח F = 10 N.
אז a = F/m, והעגלה מאיצה ב-5 m/s².
ליד כדור הארץ, g = 9.8 m/s².
